reason: I have one or two chairs and I count the drawer myself every night, so I already know my takings. ₹5,000 to start and then ₹999 every month, forever, is too much for something my notebook does for free.
objection: Monthly payment that never stops, and my boys are busy cutting hair. They will not stop to take selfies and type every walk-in's number into an English app.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: one small payment, under ₹2,000, that I pay once, with the app in Hindi or my language, and only the WhatsApp reminders so customers come back.
